note: The prerequisites gate's orphan exceptions (tools/src/gates/check-prerequisites.ts reads it in a whole run; nothing generates from it). A prerequisite record is reached when another record requires it or lists it as related, or a learning-path stage is its route — or when an entry here matches its route. An entry is { name, match, reason }: match is an exact route or a whole-route glob, reason says why the records it matches need no such path. An entry that excuses a failure rather than a category also carries owner and since. The gate fails an entry that excuses nothing, so an exception cannot outlive its cause. Edit this file, then run: make gate G=check-prerequisites.

entries.name: product-pages
entries.reason: A capability page is a product category and a comparison page one product decision. Their prerequisite edges say what the platform or the products require of you, so such a page is always the one that requires and never the one required, and no theme tours one (neither kind has a fluency block). Readers arrive from its hub and from the Implemented by list on each pattern it implements, edges this graph does not carry.
